Standard & Extended Algebraic Expressions Simplifying, expanding products, and factorising quadratic and trinomial expressions using grouping, difference of squares, and perfect squares. Expansion Rules Factorisation Difference of Squares Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Linear Equations & Inequalities Solving single and multi-step linear equations, manipulating inequalities, and graphing linear functions on the Cartesian plane. Linear Graphs Inequalities Gradient-Intercept Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Quadratic Functions Solving quadratic equations using factorisation, completing the square, and the quadratic formula. Graphing parabolas and identifying key features. Parabolas Completing the Square Discriminant Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Exponential Functions Modeling and graphing exponential growth and decay curves. Solving real-world application problems involving compound change. Exponential Growth Asymptotes Modeling Applications Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Systems of Equations Solving simultaneous linear equations using substitution, elimination, and graphical intersection. Word problem applications. Substitution Method Elimination Method Graph Intersection Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Functions & Transformations Concept of function mapping, domain, range, inverse functions, composite functions, and vertical/horizontal translations or reflections. Domain & Range Composite & Inverse Graph Shifts Explore Topic

Extended Polynomials Polynomial long division, synthetic division, and applying the Remainder and Factor theorems to factorise higher-degree polynomials. Long Division Factor Theorem Cubic Factoring Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Sequences & Series Diving deeper into arithmetic and geometric growth models, recursive definitions, sigma notation, and applications of sum to infinity. Recursive Form Sigma Notation Infinite Series Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Triangle Properties & Pythagoras Analyzing congruent and similar triangles. Applying the Pythagorean theorem in both 2D layouts and 3D geometric spaces. Pythagorean Theorem Similarity & Ratios 3D Pythagoras Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Trigonometric Ratios Standard right-angled triangle trigonometry (SOH CAH TOA). Finding unknown sides, angles of elevation, and angles of depression. SOH CAH TOA Elevation & Depression Unknown Sides & Angles Explore Topic
Extended Sine & Cosine Rules Solving oblique (non-right-angled) triangles using the Sine Rule, Cosine Rule, and the trigonometric area formula. Sine Rule Cosine Rule Trig Area Formula Explore Topic

Extended Radians & Unit Circle Introducing radian angle measure, the unit circle definition of trig functions, arc length, and sector area calculations. Radian Measures Unit Circle Sector & Arc Area Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Circle Geometry Circle theorems, chord properties, tangents, intersecting chords, angles subtended at center vs circumference, cyclic quadrilaterals. Circle Theorems Cyclic Quadrilaterals Tangents & Chords Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Perimeter, Area & Volume Calculating perimeter and area of 2D composite shapes, and surface area and volume of 3D prisms, pyramids, cylinders, cones, and spheres. Composite Area Surface Area 3D Volume Explore Topic

Extended Vectors 2D vectors, column vector notation, adding/subtracting vectors, scalar multiplication, unit vectors, and finding the scalar (dot) product. 2D Vectors Vector Arithmetic Scalar Product Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Transformations & Coordinates Applying reflections, rotations, translations, and dilations on the Cartesian coordinate grid. Finding distances and midpoints. Translations & Rotations Dilations Coordinate Geometry Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Number Systems Classification of numbers into Natural (ℕ), Integers (ℤ), Rational (ℚ), Irrational, and Real numbers (ℝ). Set relations and interval notation. ℕ, ℤ, ℚ, ℝ Rational Proofs Interval Notation Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Forms of Number Scientific notation (Standard Form $a × 10^k$), significant figures, rounding, surd simplification, and absolute values. Scientific Notation Surds & Radicals Rounding Rules Explore Topic
Standard Integer Exponents Laws of indices for positive, negative, and zero exponent powers. Simplifying complex exponential algebraic expressions. Index Laws Power Rules Simplification Explore Topic

Extended Fractional Exponents & Radicals Converting between rational exponents ($xm/n$) and radical form ($\sqrt[n]{x^m}$). Solving radical and exponential equations. Rational Indices Radicals Exponential Eqs Explore Topic
Extended Logarithms Definition of logarithmic functions, logarithmic laws (product, quotient, power), and change of base formula. Log Laws Base Conversion Solving Exponential Eqs Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Number Sequences Arithmetic and Geometric sequences, general $nth$ term formulas ($u_n$), and finite series summation ($S_n$). Arithmetic Sequences Geometric Sequences Series Summation Explore Topic
Standard Ratio & percentage Direct and inverse proportion, percentage change, compound interest, appreciation, and depreciation applications. Proportion Compound Interest Depreciation Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Sets & Venn Diagrams Set operations (Union $\cup$, Intersection $\cap$, Complement $A'$), subset notation, and multi-set Venn diagram problem solving. Set Notation Venn Diagrams Logic Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Data Collection & Presentation Types of data (qualitative, quantitative), primary and secondary data collection methods, and effective data presentation techniques. Data Types Surveys & Experiments Frequency Tables Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Graphical Data Representation Constructing and interpreting bar charts, histograms, pie charts, line graphs, and scatter plots. Identifying data distribution patterns. Bar Charts Histograms Scatter Plots Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Measures of Central Tendency Calculating and interpreting mean, median, and mode for raw and grouped data. Understanding the impact of outliers on central tendency. Mean, Median, Mode Grouped Data Outliers Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Measures of Spread Calculating and interpreting range, interquartile range (IQR), and standard deviation for raw and grouped data. Using box-and-whisker plots. Range & IQR Standard Deviation Box Plots Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Population & Sampling Distinguishing between population and sample, understanding different sampling techniques (random, stratified, convenience), and their biases. Random Sampling Stratified Sampling Sampling Bias Explore Topic

Standard & Extended Probability Calculating theoretical and experimental probabilities, understanding mutually exclusive and independent events, and using Venn diagrams and tree diagrams. Theoretical & Empirical Mutually Exclusive Tree Diagrams Explore Topic

Extended Conditional Probability Calculating probabilities of dependent events, using conditional probability formulas ($P(A|B)$), and applying Bayes' theorem in simple scenarios. Dependent Events Bayes' Theorem Contingency Tables Explore Topic

Extended Correlation & Regression Analyzing relationships between two variables using scatter plots, correlation coefficients, and linear regression lines for predictions. Scatter Plots Correlation Coefficient Line of Best Fit Explore Topic
